# ctables/mul

> Multiplication: `*` on two `int`s.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/mul.pkg) · translates [std/mul](../std/mul.md)

Evaluates the left operand, then the right, through [binop](binop.md),
then applies `*`. Overflow wraps: programs are compiled with
`-fwrapv`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
@binop
{L.a} * {L.b}; })
```

Includes: [ctables/binop](binop.md)
